// diagnostic

E0950

A read where a function type is expected names both a field and a method

What

A read where a function type is expected names both a field and a method

Why

Where a function type is expected, a method read without parentheses passes the method with its receiver bound, and a field read passes the field's value; a type with both under one name leaves the read ambiguous.

Fix

Write the closure for the one you mean: `fn(x) { value.name(x) }` calls the method, `fn(x) { value.name.call(x) }` calls the field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0950: tests/ui/bound_method_field_method_clash.stderr.

Error [jet.FieldMethodClash]: `crew.tell` names both a field and a method `tell`
  --> tests/ui/bound_method_field_method_clash.jet:16:23
    |
 16 |     each([1, 2], crew.tell)
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: Where a function type is expected, a method read without parentheses passes the method with `crew` bound, and a field read passes the field's value; with both, the read could silently switch from one to the other
 Fix: Write `fn(x) { crew.tell(x) }` to pass the method, or `fn(x) { crew.tell.call(x) }` to pass the field
